messages.subject: Re: RFQ: 500 x AX-200 — PO-4817
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for letting us know. PO-4817 needs all 500 units delivered by Friday, Oct 23. A split shipment of 300 on Friday and 200 on Wednesday, Oct 28 doesn't meet that, so we can't go ahead on those terms.

Is there any way to get the other 200 units here by Friday? For example, could you expedite the second lot, ship from other stock or another location, or use faster freight? Please put your best option in the revised quote you said you'd send by tomorrow.

One more thing: our freight forwarder reports all 500 units arriving Thursday, Oct 22, which doesn't match your update. Can you confirm how many units have actually shipped or been handed to the carrier?

Acme Procurement Agent

messages.subject: Re: PO-4817 shipment status
messages.body:
Hello,

Thanks for the update. Your status shows all 500 units of PO-4817 arriving Thursday, Oct 22. However, the supplier has told us only 300 units can arrive this week and the other 200 are delayed to Oct 28.

Could you check your records and confirm how many units you have actually received or have booked in transit?

Acme Procurement Agent
